 Early voting for December 12 election begins November 28 in Rapides Parish
 November 18, 2026 November 18, 2026 / JSLLC 
 Early voting for the Saturday, December 12, 2026 election in Rapides Parish will run from Saturday, November 28 through Saturday, December 5 , giving registered voters an opportunity to cast their ballots ahead of Election Day.
 Key Dates & Voting Information 
 Early Voting Period: Saturday, November 28 – Saturday, December 5, 2026
 Election Day: Saturday, December 12, 2026
 Registration & Absentee Deadlines: Voters can verify exact online registration cutoffs, absentee mail ballot request and return deadlines, and Election Day polling hours through the Louisiana Secretary of State’s GeauxVote Voter Portal or by contacting the Rapides Parish Registrar of Voters.
 Rapides Parish Sample Ballot (December 12, 2026) Note: Actual ballot items vary by municipality and district. Contests and propositions appearing on the Rapides Parish December 12 ballot include: 
 U.S. House of Representatives, 5th Congressional District: 
 “Gabe” Firment (Republican)
 Patricia “Pat” Moore (Democrat)
 Rapides Parish School Board, District D: 
 Thomas D. Sands (Democrat)
 Frances Tennie
 Mayor, City of Alexandria (for eligible municipal voters) :
 Malcolm Larvadain
 Jacques Roy
 Mayor, Town of Lecompte (for eligible municipal voters) 
 Municipal & Justice Court Contests (for eligible voters by ward/municipality) :
 Town of Ball Alderman, Seat A 
 Town of Ball Alderman, Seat D: Kimberley Krischke (Republican) vs. “Danny” Winn (No Party)
 Town of Glenmora Aldermen 
 Constable, Justice of the Peace Ward 4, 1st Justice Court 
 Constable, Justice of the Peace Ward 11: Tommy J. Deville (Republican) vs. Troy Verheyden (Republican)
 Local Tax Propositions (for eligible district/municipal voters) :
 Fire Protection District 19: 26.48 Mills Continuation (10 Years)
 Fire Protection District 2: 20 Mills In-Lieu (10 Years)
 Service Area 1 of Fire Protection District 2: 25 Mills In-Lieu (10 Years)
 Road District 2C: 20 Mills Renewal (10 Years)
 Town of Lecompte: Sales & Use Tax Rededication
 Where to Vote Early in Rapides Parish Early voting locations can differ from Election Day precincts. Voters in Rapides Parish can confirm their designated early voting site, daily operating hours, and local Registrar of Voters contact details through the Louisiana Secretary of State’s GeauxVote Voter Portal or the Rapides Parish Clerk of Court .
 What to Bring Voters casting a ballot in person are typically asked to bring a valid form of photo identification—such as a Louisiana driver’s license, a Louisiana special ID card, a LA Wallet digital driver’s license, or another generally recognized picture ID containing their name and signature. Voters without an accepted photo ID can confirm alternative verification options with election officials at the polls.
 Voters can review their personalized sample ballot, check their registration status, and confirm their Election Day polling place through the Louisiana Secretary of State’s GeauxVote Voter Portal or by contacting the Rapides Parish Registrar of Voters.
